chapter_description.p: The File Archiver module provides tools for compressing and decompressing files in Nelson.
It creates and extracts zip archives and tar archives (plain or compressed with gzip, zstd, xz, bzip2, lz4 or lzma).
nelson.io.archive reads and extracts archives of many other formats, such as 7z, rar, iso9660, cpio, ar, cab, lha and xar.
It also compresses and decompresses gzip and Zstandard streams, in memory or between files.
File identifiers give access to compressed data with the usual file functions (fread, fprintf, fseek, ...).
